items.title: Spot pierces a STATIC positive-gamma call wall on a frozen completed-bar frontier while breadth stays narrow and VIX eases: across the 2026-08-04 14:30 → 15:00 cutoffs the SPY dealer-gamma band is UNCHANGED (flip 755.68, call wall 765, put wall 758, signedNetGEX +4.682B, options cut asOf 10:14:20Z) yet the live bench climbs from 764.3 (below the 765 call wall) to 766.33 (above it), while market-heatmap breadth holds at 57.53% narrow and the completed daily-bar frontier stays frozen at 2026-08-03 — the upper pin cap is breached from below WITHOUT the dealer band re-forming higher, WITHOUT breadth broadening, and WITHOUT a new completed bar.
items.note: Genuinely new versus the three prior same-frontier patterns on this frontier. The 'frozen-frontier pre-market markdown' tracked live BENCH repricing (price axis), the 'coverage-expansion-on-frozen-frontier' tracked owner tools flipping to fresh reads (coverage axis), and the 'gamma-band-migration-on-frozen-frontier' tracked the dealer band itself RATCHETING UP (structure-migration axis, band moving). This is a fourth, distinct axis — a WALL-CROSS: the dealer band is held STATIC (flip + both walls + net GEX unchanged, same 10:14:20Z options cut) and price instead crosses THROUGH the static 765 call wall (764.3 → 766.33), so spot now sits above the top of the positive-gamma pin band while leadership stays narrow (57.53% both cutoffs, margin -2.47) and the deterministic regime eases slightly (VIX 16.25 → 15.86, band 'VIX 16.3' → 'VIX 15.9', score 0 both). It is the mirror of band-migration: there the band moved to meet price; here price moved through a stationary band. Emit only when the band is static AND spot crosses the call wall on a frozen frontier, so a quiet re-read that leaves price inside the band does not trip it; the breadth-static condition marks the divergence (upper pin breached, leadership still narrow, persistence unchanged).
items.method: Add a 'spot-crosses-static-call-wall-on-frozen-frontier' composite test that compares two cutoffs on the SAME session frontier (dataFreshness.bars.expectedSessionDate unchanged AND swing bar count unchanged AND freshSymbolCount==symbolCount with carriedSymbolCount==0 and missingSymbolCount==0). Assert FOUR joint conditions: (1) FRONTIER FROZEN across the two cutoffs; (2) BAND STATIC = the dealer-gamma flip AND both walls AND signedNetGEX are unchanged within a small tolerance across the cutoffs AND the options-cut asOf is identical (here flip 755.68, callWall 765, putWall 758, netGEX +4.682B, options asOf 2026-08-04T10:14:20Z, all unchanged); (3) WALL CROSS = the live bench moves from at-or-below the callWall to strictly above it across the cutoffs (here 764.3 → 766.33 through the 765 wall); (4) BREADTH-STATIC GUARD = market-heatmap breadthPct (or the leadership label) is UNCHANGED across the cutoffs (here 57.53% narrow both). Emit the experimental flag only when (1) AND (2) AND (3) hold; the additional breadth-static condition (4) marks the divergence — spot pierced the upper pin cap while the dealer band stayed put and leadership stayed narrow, with no new completed bar added.
